lines.zh: 我走在浅水里，脚不扬起泥
lines.en: I walk in shallow water without stirring the mud.

lines.zh: 我的脚步没有声音，水面却动
lines.en: My steps are silent, yet the water moves.

lines.zh: 水顺着我的身体往下流
lines.en: Water runs down my body.

lines.zh: 我一步一步往前走，水退在我身后
lines.en: I go forward and the water retreats behind me.

lines.zh: 我的影子在水里是倒的
lines.en: My shadow hangs upside down in the water.

lines.zh: 我从水面上走过去，像踩着地
lines.en: I cross the water as if it were ground.

lines.zh: 我经过的地方水变深了
lines.en: The water deepens where I pass.
I look down at what is in the water.
There are no ripples under my feet.

lines.zh: 我一直朝声音的方向走
lines.en: I keep walking toward the sound.

lines.zh: 我踩过浅水，水在脚后合上。
lines.en: I walk the shallows, and the water closes behind my heels.

lines.zh: 我从水里走过一块石头
lines.en: I walk across a stone in the water.
I stand in the water, ankle deep.
The surface is flat as cloth.
I look to the far waterline.
The water shows me, and it is not right.

lines.zh: 我低头，水面映出我的脸。
lines.en: I lower my head and the water shows my face.
The reflection moves first.

lines.zh: 我的脚不动，水自己在转
lines.en: My feet are still, and the water turns.
A drop sounds in the distance.
I raise a hand, water falling through.

lines.zh: 这一带的水都是我走过的
lines.en: The water here is all water I have crossed.
I turn my head to the sound of water.
A little light rests on the water.

lines.zh: 我的脚在水底踩得很稳
lines.en: My feet sit steady on the bottom.
I stand in the water as if waiting.
I raise my eyes from the water.

lines.zh: 你站在干地上，我在水里
lines.en: You stand on dry ground; I am in the water.
The ground under you is turning wet.
The water edges toward you.
I do not move; the water will go.
My reflection is behind you.

lines.zh: 你低头看水里，水里也有我
lines.en: You look down, and I am there too.
I take one slow step toward you.
The water only covers my feet.
Your shoes are wet already.

lines.zh: 我开口，声音像从水里出来
lines.en: I speak, and my voice comes from the water.
I watch you from beneath the water.

lines.zh: 你走到哪里，水就跟到哪里
lines.en: Wherever you walk, the water follows.
I lean slowly toward the bank.
My hand opens under the water.
You should not stand in this low place.
The face in the water is not yours.

lines.zh: 我一直没抬头，你也没走
lines.en: I have not looked up, and you have not left.
Bubbles begin at my feet.
You give a step; the water takes one.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，水响了一下
lines.en: I give half a step and the water sounds.
My reflection wavers.

lines.zh: 水从我身上退开又回来
lines.en: The water pulls away from me and returns.
I cover where I was struck.

lines.zh: 我沉下去一截，又浮起来
lines.en: I sink a stretch, then rise.
My reflection breaks into pieces.
The water pulls away from me.
I press my chest, my hand wet.

lines.zh: 我慢慢往水里退，倒影碎成几块。
lines.en: I back into the water and my reflection breaks apart.
The ground is slipping from under my feet.
I do not eat what you hold.

lines.zh: 我只是想让你站到水里来
lines.en: I only want you to step into the water.
The water will bring it to me.
You hold it up and stand firm.

lines.zh: 我慢慢蹲下去，手放进水里
lines.en: I crouch and put a hand in the water.

lines.zh: 水面起了一圈纹，朝你去了
lines.en: A ring spreads across the water, toward you.
I reach out, my hand on the surface.
Lower that thing a little.

lines.zh: 水里有很多东西，可这个不一样
lines.en: There is much in the water, but this is different.
I draw it under the water.

lines.zh: 你撞在我身上，身上湿了
lines.en: You hit me and end up wet.
My body is colder than it looks.
Water spills out between us.
You step back, and the water deepens.
I catch you, and my hand is wet.
You step into the water.
Water runs into your shoes.

lines.zh: 我扶住你，你就站不稳了
lines.en: I steady you, and you lose your footing.
We collide and the splash is low.

lines.zh: 我的手臂在水里滑过你的腿
lines.en: My arm slides past your leg underwater.
She is in the water too, to her knees.

lines.zh: 我们站着，水面在我们之间动
lines.en: We stand, and the water moves between us.

lines.zh: 她低头看倒影，我也低头
lines.en: She looks at the reflection; so do I.

lines.zh: 我们的影子在水里叠起来
lines.en: Our shadows fold together in the water.

lines.zh: 她没有说话，水替她说了
lines.en: She says nothing; the water speaks for her.

lines.zh: 她的手在水里碰我的手
lines.en: Her hand meets mine under the water.
We walk deeper together.
Her reflection lies over mine.

lines.zh: 我们站着，水面起了细纹
lines.en: We stand and fine ripples cross the surface.

lines.zh: 她把手放在我肩上，衣服湿了
lines.en: She rests a hand on my shoulder, her sleeve wet.
I bend and reach into the water.

lines.zh: 水把东西托起来，送到我手上
lines.en: The water lifts it to my hand.
I hold it, still dripping.
I set it at your feet.
The water follows my hand.
I fish it up from the bottom.
It drips in my hand.
I lift it above the surface.
Water falls from it back into the water.
I set it before your feet.
I stop, and the water stills.
I raise my eyes to you.
The water begins to move your way.
My feet make no sound at all.
You step back, and the water arrives first.

lines.zh: 我站直了，水从我身上落
lines.en: I straighten and water falls off me.
I tip my head your way.
The water is at your ankles.

lines.zh: 水先漫到你脚边，我才动。
lines.en: Water reaches your boots first, then I move.
My reflection reaches your feet first.
I do not need to move fast.
There is water behind you too.

lines.zh: 我把手从水里慢慢抬起
lines.en: I raise my hand slowly out of the water.
The water deepens under me.
You retreat; the water goes with you.

lines.zh: 我一直看着你，没有眨眼
lines.en: I have not blinked.

lines.zh: 我一步一步地走，水跟着
lines.en: I walk step by step, and the water follows.
Wherever you go, the water goes.

lines.zh: 我的倒影一直贴在你脚边
lines.en: My reflection stays at your feet.
You lift a foot, and your sole is soaked.
I am in no hurry; the water will tire first.
I walk in the water and it gives way.

lines.zh: 你踩到的地方开始渗水
lines.en: Water seeps where you step.
I press forward step by step.

lines.zh: 水面把我的位置藏住了
lines.en: The surface hides my position.
You look for me; I am in the water.

lines.zh: 我把两只手都放进水里
lines.en: I put both hands into the water.
The water turns at your feet.
I stay three steps from you.

lines.zh: 你走到高处，我也跟上去
lines.en: You move to high ground; I follow.
Something moves under my feet.
You cannot hear my steps.
I move along the surface, very low.
Your shoes have filled with water.
I do not shout; the water shouts.

lines.zh: 我踩过的地方，水跟着涨。
lines.en: Wherever I step, the water rises behind me.
I reach out of the water.

lines.zh: 我的手抓住你的手腕，很凉
lines.en: My hand closes on your wrist, cold.
I push, and the water surges with it.
The water is at your knees.
My hand comes out of the water.
I catch your ankle.
I push, and water surges to your waist.

lines.zh: 我的手指很凉，扣得很紧
lines.en: My fingers are cold and grip hard.
I strike your legs from underwater.
You struggle, and spray rises.
I press down on your shoulder.
I stand at your back, and the water follows.
My movement is slow; the water arrives first.
You pull back, and the water stays at your feet.

lines.zh: 我抓空了，水却抓住了你
lines.en: I miss, but the water holds you.
After the blow I withdraw into the water.
The surface stirs first.

lines.zh: 水面鼓起一块，我直起身。
lines.en: The surface bulges and I rise upright.
Water pours off me.
No ripple shows under my feet.

lines.zh: 水里多了一个不对的倒影
lines.en: There is one reflection too many in the water.
I raise my eyes to the bank.
The water at the bank rises first.
I rise slowly out of the water.

lines.zh: 水从我身上一层层落下
lines.en: Water falls off me in layers.

lines.zh: 我的倒影先出现，我才出现
lines.en: My reflection appears before I do.

lines.zh: 我站在浅水里，水到脚背
lines.en: I stand in the shallows, water to my feet.
The light on the water breaks.

lines.zh: 我沉在深处，只露一张脸。
lines.en: I sink deep, only my face showing.
I raise a hand and water falls from it.
I take one step toward the bank.
The ground under you darkens.
I stop, and the water keeps moving.

lines.zh: 水里有很多影子，只有一个是我的
lines.en: Many shadows in the water; only one is mine.

lines.zh: 我把身上最后一层水抖掉
lines.en: I shake off the last layer of water.

lines.zh: 我站在这里，水面就静了
lines.en: I stand here and the surface stills.

lines.zh: 火在水面上烧，水汽起来，我退了
lines.en: Fire burns on the water, steam rises, and I retreat.
I drop into deep water without a sound.

lines.zh: 水是我的，可这一下太深了
lines.en: The water is mine, but this is too deep.

lines.zh: 爆炸把水掀起来，水墙砸在我身上
lines.en: The blast throws the water up into a wall that hits me.

lines.zh: 有东西穿进水里，扎到我
lines.en: Something passes through the water and into me.

lines.zh: 那股力量把水从我身边赶开
lines.en: That force drives the water away from me.

lines.zh: 水没有养分，我也慢慢淡了
lines.en: The water holds no nourishment, and I grow faint.

lines.zh: 雷落进水里，一路通到我身上
lines.en: Lightning strikes the water and runs to me.

lines.zh: 水散了，脚下什么都没有
lines.en: The water scatters, and there is nothing underfoot.
